waivers.reason: The project owner explicitly approved Worker 1.1.0 as a bridge release even though the final LDA classifier head was fit on 1,410 E/M/H development ROIs instead of only the single_objects 200-image source. This exception does not apply to 1.1.1 or later.

The project owner explicitly approved Worker 1.1.0 without a new unseen locked test. E/M/H and the rejected 115-image operational collection remain development evidence and are not relabeled as independent.

remaining_limitations: The production classifier LDA head was trained on all 1,410 E/M/H development ROIs; its 1,410/1,410 result is not independent validation.
The 115-image operational collection was opened for the rejected v2 candidate and then used to tune v3, so it remains development_only.

Worker 1.1.1 and later must train every classifier parameter, fitted statistic, calibration value, approval threshold, and ranking policy only from the frozen single_objects 200-image manifest and deterministic derivatives of those images.
A new capture session that passes identity and provenance preflight is still required for independent promotion evidence for the 200-image-only successor.

post_promotion_registry_cleanup.note: References to an unavailable legacy development source were removed. The production 1.1.0 binaries remain unchanged, and the canonical registry now contains only E/M/H records.
